title: tune-nccl-overlap-kv-cache-kernel-scheduling-tensor-parallel
author: Ethan Morales
description: Motivation: multi-GPU tensor-parallel inference showed suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and device compute when KV cache continuous batching is enabled. This PR applies a set of coordinated changes to kernel scheduling, NCCL stream prioritization, and KV cache batching to increase overlap, reduce end-to-end latency tail, and improve GPU utilization in production TP tests. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a lightweight kernel scheduler hook that reorders non-blocking kernels to favor compute on the main inference stream while offloading large collective launches to lower-priority streams. 2) Adjust NCCL stream priorities and associate all collective launches for TP all-reduce/all-gather with explicit stream attributes to reduce cross-stream synchronization stalls. 3) Add adaptive KV cache flush windows when continuous batching is active so that KV cache inserts are batched but can be force-flushed on model-change or long-running sequences to avoid stalling collectives. 4) Tune CUDA event placement and stream synchronization points to avoid unnecessary device-wide synchronizations during asynchronous collectives. 5) Add metrics and tracing hooks to observe per-GPU time spent in compute vs. comm and to annotate traces with NCCL op ids for postmortem analysis. Backwards compatibility: changes are behind a runtime feature flag (tp_nccL_overlap_v2) and guarded by config defaults to preserve current behaviour unless enabled. Testing: microbenchmarks across 2/4/8 GPU TP shapes, internal canary with Redwood Dedicated, and stress tests with continuous batching workloads. Results: +18-27% median throughput for 8-GPU TP model under mixed prompt lengths, 12-33% reduction in P99 latency on steady-state continuous-batching workloads, and 8-14% better average GPU SM utilization in our internal lab. Risk/notes: very low-level changes to stream ordering and kernel launch paths; reviewed with SRE and low-level runtime owners. Rollout plan: enable behind feature flag, staged canary on dedicated pools, monitor new metrics and rollback on anomaly. This PR bundles code changes, small API to expose tracing ids, and documentation updates to the TP tuning guide.
